## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `030220ea73955e9e7f00068db538827cfce73172`
Local-runs: probe — check-handover.mjs --self-test at the head: its header's ruling keeps it out of every workflow, so no check-run answers its 18 new inflight cases; run once offline from a git-archive export of the head in scratch, with the ④ break inputs in the same call (an earlier call read main's tree because FETCH_HEAD had moved, and was discarded)
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs + scripts/pm/round-open.mjs, scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs, scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs, package.json
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #37878 (card #35237, slice 4 plus carrier items 1 and 2), rules face. No must-fix. S1, S2 and S3 below are open on this head and earn a delta review of their fix; each is a path where a new reader prints a clean answer it has not earned. N1 to N6 are nits.

Gates on this head when read: 44 check-runs success, 14 skipped, 6 in progress (Test UI shards 1, 3, 4, 11, 14 and 16 of 16), none red. The diff touches no `ui/**` path. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` is green; it runs `check:pm-prior-rulings` (round-open's self-test included), `check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-half-states` and `check-self-test-wired`. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` and `Check Changeset` are green.

### ① Derived judgments

- `hits` are four, not the three the brief lists: `reviewFace` on this file list also returns `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (a governed path). It is reviewed as a `hits` file.
- `HANDOFF_TARGET` accept set: adds `repo:NAME#N` (the name may carry `.`, `-`, `_`) and `epic:#N#k`; `l2-review#N`, `review#N` and `domain:LANE#N` read as before; `triage`, a seat with no number, `repo:#2`, `epic:#N` and `epic:N#k` stay unreadable. Right. It is carrier item 1 (7181970862). No gate reads the line; its one consumer, `takerOf` in `check-owed-reviews.mjs`, prints the target verbatim and tests for an L2 lane on the text before the first `#`, which holds for both new shapes. A dotted repo seat is live (`repo:www.objectos.ai`, `mailbox-open.mjs:610`).
- `card-pick.mjs` docblock and `UNREAD_LEGS` lane-ownership leg: wording only, no behaviour. Right against `execution-duties.md` line 50 and `area-lease.md` line 47 (domain seats retired, `domain:*` is file ownership only; cloud and security cards still not claimed).
- `check-handover.mjs` CLI: new mode `--inflight` with `--paths`, `--card` and its own exit 5; `--repo` validation moves ahead of the mode split; the `pm:dispatched` listing becomes `readDispatched` with the same ceiling and the same truncated throw. Right, and behaviour-preserving for the handover mode. `FLEET_BOT_LOGIN`, which the queue guard loads from this file, is untouched and the module loads at the head (probe).
- `round-open.mjs`: new CLI, exits 0, 2, 3, 4, 5 (usage is 2 here and 1 in `check-handover.mjs`; each documents its own). Its self-test joins `check:pm-prior-rulings` in `package.json`. Right.
- The three skill files: every changed line keeps its rule sentence and names the reader, the done-when form of 7017468070. Right.
- Readings `round-open.mjs` had to choose, since the rule text does not spell them: reading 2 is any seat-signed comment after the brief (a superset of the marker; right, it only adds self-exits); the brief is read on its headline from any author (right by lines 6 and 13, which bind the brief to no session); a push counts on a lane card this seat claims or nobody claims (right; conservative on an area two seats share); reading 4 is timed by the claiming session's newest comment on the card, not by the close (acceptable and declared: a merge closes a card); 非豁免 is the same-seat filter (acceptable: no other exemption is written anywhere under `pm-dispatch/`). The lane as the post title's intake keys is wrong: S1.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff publishes nothing. It changes `scripts/pm/**`, three `.claude/**` reference files and one `scripts` entry of the private root `package.json`. `Check Changeset` is green on the head. `Clause-②: no` holds: nothing a consumer can author, call or read changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in the dev report (7213710664).
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the diff holds no query. The new reads are REST listings; the label and `since` filters are pushed to the API, and thread reads are bounded by the round window.
- One round as 60 minutes (`ROUND_MINUTES`): answered, accepted as the reading. `seat-lifecycle.md` gives no number, `SKILL.md` line 73 defines a round by its end, and `contract-review.md` line 25 carries the only figure under `pm-dispatch/`. A round that runs past 60 minutes with no new trace reads CLEAR. The flag is overridable and the self-test pins the phrase. Escalated to the seat as a carrier: the number belongs on the rule line, which is rule text and not this PR's to add.
- `check-handover.mjs` self-test stays unwired, by the ruling its header quotes (6162084315, letter A): answered, holds. That is why this review ran it once: 85 cases pass at the head.
- The in-flight surface reader is new, not borrowed from `dispatch-gates.mjs`' private `FILE_SURFACE_KEY_LINE`: answered, accepted while that file is serial behind #37064. The two key-line spellings should become one when carrier item 3 opens that file.
- Out-of-scope items the report marks "noted, not filed": the `SKILL.md` line 184 pointer to `check-handover.mjs --inflight`, and the hand-off TEMPLATE placeholder with its verbatim copy in `contract-review.md`. Escalated to the seat: each needs a carrier note on #35237, which stays open. Until the first lands, the in-flight rule's own line names no reader.
- Branch cut from `e69fa46d` and merged with `02ed8408`: answered. No file of this diff has changed on `main` since that merge base.
- The dev's one red local gate (`check-self-test-workflow-commands`, a timeout under load): answered by the head's check-runs, which are green.
- `execution-duties.md` line 50 and `area-lease.md` line 37 edits: inside the claimed surface, judged in ④.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` (hits). Line 5 gains the pointer; line 9 loses only the retyped procedure and keeps 推即认领,欠一条 `Claim:`. Read against `round-open.mjs` sentence by sentence: lines 5, 6, 7, 9, 11 (executing seats only; lease sessions through `--own`), 12 (director refused) and 13 (`mutexVerdict` clears every activity at or before the brief) agree. Lines 8 and 10 do not, in one respect: S1. Line 14 (the maintainer's summon) is named as unread on every run.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` (hits). Line 31 keeps the rule and names the reader. Line 37 drops the `scripts/pm/` prefix, as the sibling pointers spell names. Holds, with N3: an area session that runs the reader as pointed gets YIELD on its own seat's PM session until it passes that session with `--own`.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (hits). Line 42 keeps the rule and names `check-handover.mjs --inflight`; the mode reads every open `pm:dispatched` claim, a superset of the `domain:ui` claims the line asks for. Line 50 states the rule alone and agrees with the new `card-pick.mjs` footer. The pointer holds only as far as the reader does: S2, S3.

`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (hits). The regex was walked against every row and control in the two new self-test cases and against `repo:a#1#2` and `epic:#35205#1#2` (both unreadable, the tail is no tier token). It holds against carrier item 1 and its consumer. N6.

`scripts/pm/round-open.mjs` (implementing).

S1 (should-fix) — Readings 3 and 4 walk only cards under the post title's intake keys (`onIntake`, lines 300, 324, 340, 366). A seat's claims lawfully sit outside those keys: `card-pick.mjs` rules 1 and 2 on `main` pick p0 and p1 from any area, and on this card seat 4 took it as "p1 outside area:cloud and area:ux" (7129081501). A claim, a push or a closed card of this seat by another session on such a card, inside the round, reads CLEAR, and neither a gap nor a footer leg says the walk stopped at the intake. Line 7 makes the claim the one trace that cannot be missing, so this is the reading the mutex rests on when the marker was skipped. Fix: read same-seat claims on every open `pm:dispatched` ∪ `pm:queue` card updated inside the window (the window already bounds the thread reads) and on the closed listing, or name the leg in `UNREAD_LEGS` and on the CLEAR line.

N1 (nit) — Reading 2 keeps the newest seat-signed comment whoever wrote it, so an own or `--own` comment newer than another session's marker hides that marker. Line 6 says "newest", so the code agrees with the text; keeping the newest comment by a session outside `own`, as reading 3 does, costs nothing.

N2 (nit) — `seatOfPostTitle` is a new spelling of a reading `fleet-roster.mjs:276` already has (`· seat N` anywhere in the name half), against the header's "every reader is borrowed". And `--post` cannot rescue a title the reader does not parse: line 289 pushes a gap, so the run ends at exit 4 whatever USAGE says about `--post`. It fails closed.

N3 (nit) — A `mode:remote` dev's push, a head commit with no `Claude-Session:` trailer (a platform merge of `main`), and, from an area session's side, the seat's PM session all read foreign until passed with `--own`. USAGE and the YIELD line name only the lease table's area sessions. The YIELD line could say that `--own` clears a session the seat knows as its own.

`scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` `--inflight` (implementing). Probe inputs and results are quoted with each finding.

S2 (should-fix) — `inflightSurface` applies every fence to the whole union, blind to order (line 600). A path that a later `Claim amendment` adds is removed when the claim before it fenced that name. Probe: a claim with "Not `dispatch-gates.mjs`", then an amendment whose surface is `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, reads paths `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` only, and `--paths=scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` exits 0. This card's own claim (7212701571) carries exactly that fence and takes carrier item 3 next, on the fleet's most serial file. The self-test pins only the other direction (a later fence over an earlier path). Fix: a fence removes only what was declared at or before it; the newest declaration wins.

S3 (should-fix) — `surfacesMeet` reads a claimed entry that carries a slash as root-relative (line 554), so a path fragment meets nothing and the card is not listed as unread. Probe: `lanes/director.md` against `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` is false, and so is `references/contract-review.md` against its full path; the run exits 0. The first spelling is on this card's own thread (claim 7006559529), and `references/NAME.md` is how the fleet's prose names skill files. Fix: a claimed entry that matches a dispatch path on a whole-segment suffix meets it, reported like a bare name; or the card is listed as unread.

N4 (nit) — Three more entries drop without a word when the claim names other paths: a clause opening `No changes outside …` reads its path as fenced; a bare root directory (`docs`, `ui`) is no path token; a literal `.claude` reads as a file with an extension and meets no glob under it (probe: false). A claimed bare file name never meets a `DIR/**` or bare-directory dispatch entry (probe: false for `scripts/pm/**` and `scripts/pm/`); that one is declared and pinned, and the trade is sound, but exit 0 still prints "clear". Listing the claimed entries that were not compared would make the clean line true.

N5 (nit) — The header says "conservative where it cannot tell, in the direction of reporting"; the bare-name rule and S3 go the other way. The sentence should say which cases report and which do not.

`scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs` (implementing). Text only; agrees with the rule lines named in ①. The new CLI-battery case pins both the retired phrases gone and the new one present. Holds.

`package.json` (implementing). One chain entry; the job that runs it is green on the head. Holds.

N6 (nit) — `record-recognisers.mjs`: the comment on `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE` still says the verbatim pin keeps the text and `HANDOFF_TARGET` from drifting apart, while the placeholder names one retired sibling spelling and the reader now takes two more. It rides the template carrier in ③.

Rule-change: every `.claude/**` hunk is a pointer, a dropped procedure step or wording; none alters what an agent may do without the maintainer, what gets done and in what order, or what must go to him. `none` matches the PR body.

Not reviewed here, the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`: the one comment in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `935adc314147bfd574e08181013c20fc423c5244`
Local-runs: probe — check-handover.mjs --self-test at the new head, which no workflow runs: one offline call from a git-archive export of the head in scratch, with the delta's break inputs on both readers in the same call
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs + scripts/pm/round-open.mjs, scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs, scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs, package.json
Security-touching: no

This is a DELTA record on PR #37878 (card #35237). Record 7214100600 on head `030220ea` left S1, S2 and S3 open. The delta `030220ea..935adc31` is two fast-forward commits touching `scripts/pm/round-open.mjs` and `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` only.

S1: closed

S2: closed

S3: closed

No must-fix. Two narrower findings are new on this head, S4 and S5 below; each is what remains of S1 and S3 on one input, and each earns a delta review of its fix.

Gates on this head: all 60 check-runs completed, 50 success and 10 skipped, none red, none running. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` is green (round-open's self-test rides it), as are `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `PR-body guards`. `Check Changeset` reads skipped, the `skip-changeset` label's job-level exemption.

### ① Derived judgments

- The four `hits` files, `card-pick.mjs` and `package.json` are byte-identical to `030220ea`; record 7214100600 judged them and that judgment carries.
- `round-open.mjs`: readings 3 and 4 now walk every open `pm:dispatched` ∪ `pm:queue` card and every closed card updated inside the window, on the intake or off it. Right: it is the reading S1 asked for, and the window still bounds the thread reads (the dev's live run read 41 threads, was 5).
- `round-open.mjs`: reading 2 skips comments signed by an own session (`postReadings` takes `own`). Right; it is N1, and it makes readings 2 and 3 filter alike.
- `round-open.mjs`: a post title with no intake no longer ends the run early; readings 3 and 4 are taken and the gap names only the push leg. Right; the exit is still 4.
- `check-handover.mjs`: `inflightSurface` reads the claim and its amendments in thread order; a fence removes only what was declared at or before it. Right; probe: the answer does not depend on the order the rows arrive in.
- `check-handover.mjs`: `meetKind` replaces the boolean and adds a `suffix` reading for a claimed path fragment; `surfacesMeet` stays as its boolean. Right for a dispatch file path. Not consistent for a dispatch directory: S5.
- `check-handover.mjs`: a clear run lists claimed bare names it did not compare; a clause opening `No changes outside …` is surface. Right, with N8.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: the delta publishes nothing, `skip-changeset` holds and `Clause-②: no` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in the dev report (7214634452).
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the delta holds no query.
- S1 widens the reads: answered, accepted. The window bounds them and the run prints the count.
- N2 and N6 left by the seat's order: answered, they stay accepted deviations. The single-segment tokens of N4 (`docs`, `ui`, `.claude`) also stay unread, as the report says.
- The PR body still quotes 32 and 85 cases and the round-0 fence and fragment readings: escalated to the seat, which owes the refresh. This record judged the tree.
- The carriers from record 7214100600 (the `SKILL.md` line 184 pointer, the hand-off template with `contract-review.md`, the round's number on the rule line) are untouched by the delta and still owed.

### ④ Design judgment

`scripts/pm/round-open.mjs`. The S1 shape is pinned (a claim of this seat by another session on a p1 card off the intake yields) and so is an off-intake closed card. Probe: the self-test passes, 36 cases. N1 and N3 are taken as written.

S4 (should-fix) — The push leg reads an off-intake card only when `seatCards` holds it, and `seatCards` is filled inside the loop that skips every card not updated in the window (the `continue` before `seatCards.add`). A push does not move a card's `updated_at`. So a card off the intake that another session of this seat claimed more than one round ago, with a push ten minutes old, reads CLEAR with no thread and no commit read; the same card on the intake reads YIELD (probe: exit 0 against exit 5). The push is the only fresh trace a long round leaves on such a card, and p0 and p1 cards from other areas are a seat's first picks. The footer leg names only "an off-intake card no claim names", which is a different case. Fix: match heads against every open `pm:dispatched` card and let the existing holder check keep this seat's (an unclaimed one still counts on the intake only), or name this leg in `UNREAD_LEGS` and in reading 3 of the header.

`scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` `--inflight`. Probe: the self-test passes, 90 cases. Both S2 directions hold on a three-step thread. Both S3 spellings meet their full paths as `suffix`, and a partial segment does not. N5 is taken as written.

S5 (should-fix) — One directory, two spellings, two answers. `references/contract-review.md` meets the dispatch entry `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references` as a suffix, but against `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` it meets nothing, is not listed NOT COMPARED (that listing takes bare names only) and the run prints "clear" (probe: `suffix`, then null, exit 0, empty list). `DIR/**` is how the claim template's directory surface is usually spelled on `--paths`. The `meetKind` docblock says both: its `suffix` line has a fragment meet a dispatch directory it starts inside, and its closing paragraph says a fragment against a bare directory is no meeting. Fix: read a trailing `/**` as its directory in the suffix arm, and make the docblock say what the code does.

N7 (nit) — A fragment that sits deeper inside the dispatch directory (`lanes/director.md` against `…/references` or `…/references/**`) meets nothing and is not listed. This reader cannot tell it from a root-relative path, so not judging it is sound; but the header's "a clear run says what it did not judge" is true for names only. One standing sentence on the clear line would cover it. A claimed fragment that is itself a glob or a directory (`references/*.md`, `references/lanes`) is not suffix-read either.

N8 (nit) — The NOT COMPARED listing skips a single-segment dispatch directory: `--paths=scripts/` against a claimed `card-pick.mjs` lists nothing, while `scripts/pm/` and `scripts/**` each list it (probe: 0, 1, 1). `notComparable` asks for a slash in the entry after the trailing one is stripped.

N9 (nit) — The suffix arm also fires for a root-relative claimed path whose first segment is the dispatch directory's last: `ui/packages` against `packages/spec/src/x.ts`, `ui/skills` against `skills/…`. It reports, which is the safe direction, and prints the pair as "a path fragment on the claim". Accepted; the label could say the path may be root-relative.

Nits from record 7214100600: N1, N3 and N5 are fixed; N4 is fixed in part (N8 and the single-segment tokens remain); N2 and N6 stand as accepted deviations.

Rule-change: the delta touches no `.claude/**` file, and the hunks verified in record 7214100600 are unchanged. `none` matches the PR body.

Not reviewed here, the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`: the one comment in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, unchanged in the delta.
